answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Clockmaker mainspring assay stamped by the craft hall flips the bet — each mainspring is a measured rate sheet plus a master signature, so a farm must build a hundred real clocks by hand — and the terrace lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the mirror of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The fable is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
